closeout_note: Finding statements are copied from original-terminal/findings.json. No new source inspection was performed. No finding was narrowed or expanded.

findings.title: Liquidation health includes signed PnL; collateral sufficiency does not credit positive PnL
evidence: source/contracts/position/PositionUtils.sol:414-421 remainingCollateralUsd = collateralUsd + positionPnlUsd + priceImpactUsd - collateralCostUsd
source/contracts/position/PositionUtils.sol:441-446 nonpositive remaining equity and min-collateral-for-leverage are liquidation conditions
source/contracts/position/PositionUtils.sol:403-404 liquidation-health fee calculation sets isLiquidation false so liquidation fees are not included
source/contracts/position/PositionUtils.sol:488-503 willPositionCollateralBeSufficient deducts negative realizedPnlUsd and explicitly does not factor positive PnL
findings.statement: These are distinct observations. Unsettled PnL is counted in liquidation health and is not spendable collateral or withdrawable cash. A later PnL-as-cash mutant must target the wrong observation, not erase PnL from the health equation and call that source fidelity.

findings.title: Funding is an unsigned fee plus separate long/short claimables with opposing rounding
evidence: source/contracts/pricing/PositionPricingUtils.sol:488-507 fundingFeeAmount uses getFundingAmount(..., true); claimable long/short use getFundingAmount(..., false)
source/contracts/market/MarketUtils.sol:1982-2006 unsigned fundingDiffFactor times size via Precision.mulDiv; comments require fee round-up and claimable round-down
source/contracts/market/MarketUtils.sol:606-654 claimableFundingAmountKey(market, token, account) increment and claimFundingFees transferOut
findings.statement: Do not collapse funding into one signed cash balance. Fee liability, long claimable tokens, and short claimable tokens have different rounding and storage keys. Claim is a separate transfer path, not automatic settlement into position collateral.

findings.title: Actual refusals and allowed insolvent close are different source paths
evidence: source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionUtils.sol:220-238 liquidation orders revert Errors.PositionShouldNotBeLiquidated when isPositionLiquidatable is false
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:80-85 isInsolventCloseAllowed requires full sizeDeltaUsd and liquidation or secondary ADL

source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:637-661 handleEarlyReturn reverts InsufficientFundsToPayForCosts when insolvent close is disallowed; otherwise emitInsolventClose and return empty fees
source/contracts/position/PositionUtils.sol:306-313 validatePosition reverts LiquidatablePosition; DecreasePositionUtils.sol:316-335 applies that only when remaining size is nonzero
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionUtils.sol:152-157 UnableToWithdrawCollateral when sizeDeltaUsd==0 and collateral would be insufficient
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:256-260 EmptyHoldingAddress when secondary-token funding payment has no holding address
source/contracts/liquidation/LiquidationUtils.sol:28-105 createLiquidationOrder does not itself test isPositionLiquidatable
findings.statement: Task 28.1 must select an actual source guard. Do not invent a refusal, and do not treat allowed full liquidation or secondary-ADL insolvency as executor failure. PositionShouldNotBeLiquidated refuses liquidation of a healthy position. InsufficientFundsToPayForCosts refuses ordinary unpaid costs. LiquidatablePosition refuses leaving a remaining non-zero position in a liquidatable state on ordinary paths. createLiquidationOrder is not that admission check.

findings.title: Funding shortfall and insolvent residual events are not insurance payouts
evidence: source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:275-287 emitInsufficientFundingFeePayment; comments mention pool top-up, insurance fund, or similar and do not execute them
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:652-661 emitInsolventClose records remainingCostUsd and payment step then returns empty fees
source/contracts/liquidation/LiquidationUtils.sol:54-59 comments about protocol-fund refund of price impact are not executable compensation in this library
findings.statement: Shortfall events do not imply residual coverage. Later Margin accounting must keep remainingCostUsd as an explicit residual, not as a proved insurance claim or automatic top-up.

findings.title: Secondary cost conversion uses integer division; remainingCostUsd is source-rounded
evidence: source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:579 Calc.roundUpDivision(costUsd, collateralTokenPrice.min)
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:611 remainingCostInOutputToken * collateralTokenPrice.min / secondaryOutputTokenPrice.min
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:625 remainingCostUsd = remainingCostInSecondaryOutputToken * secondaryOutputTokenPrice.min
source/contracts/position/DecreasePositionCollateralUtils.sol:548-558 withdrawal capped to remainingCollateralAmount token units
findings.statement: Do not silently equate source remainingCostUsd with exact rational unpaid debt. Primary cost is rounded up in collateral-token units. Secondary conversion truncates. Withdrawal is capped in remaining token units, not unrealized equity.

findings.title: Oracle, custody, caller role, holding address, and handlers remain explicit assumptions
evidence: selected oracle files are IOracle.sol and OracleUtils.sol only; no Oracle.sol implementation in this slice
source/contracts/bank/Bank.sol:34-38 transferOut is onlyController
source/contracts/role/RoleModule.sol:139-140 onlyLiquidationKeeper exists; no LiquidationHandler or AdlHandler file in the 89 captured sources
source/contracts/role/Role.sol:94-97 LIQUIDATION_KEEPER key is declared
source/test/exchange/LiquidationOrder.ts:51 grants LIQUIDATION_KEEPER; that test was not executed
findings.statement: Prices, token custody, keeper authorization, and holding-address configuration are not proved by this packet. Task 28.1 may freeze them as assumptions. Absence of the handler from the selected slice is coverage for later entry, not an identity mismatch in the captured files.

findings.title: Ten nonempty creation objects retain unresolved library links

CallbackUtils, FeeUtils, LiquidationUtils, MarketUtils, DecreasePositionCollateralUtils, DecreasePositionUtils, IncreasePositionUtils, PositionUtils, ReferralUtils, SwapUtils
